skill.name: ai-video-generation
skill.description: Generate, edit, upscale, and combine AI videos through the inference.sh belt CLI using supported video models.
skill.summary: Create AI video workflows with inference.sh models for text, image, avatar, editing, audio, and upscaling tasks.
skill.author: 101-skills

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around model IDs, command examples, and links. I found no prompt injection text, credential reads, or hidden code execution in SKILL.md. The main risk is expected data egress through the authenticated belt CLI and external model providers.

remediation.suggestion: State that belt sends prompts, image URLs, audio URLs, and video URLs to inference.sh and model providers.
Pin the referenced belt skill or provide a verified version and checksum for users who install it.
Add guidance to avoid secrets, private recordings, or sensitive client media unless the user has approval.

| Veo 3.1 Fast | `google/veo-3-1-fast` | Fast, with optional audio |

| **Seedance 2.0** | `bytedance/seedance-2-0` | Animate images with sync audio, up to 1080p |
| HappyHorse Edit | `alibaba/happyhorse-1-0-video-edit` | Natural language video editing |
| HunyuanVideo Foley | `infsh/hunyuanvideo-foley` | Add sound effects to video |
| Media Merger | `infsh/media-merger` | Merge videos with transitions |
Generate videos with 40+ AI models via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh) CLI.
- [Running Apps](https://inference.sh/docs/apps/running) - How to run apps via CLI

semantic_findings.title: Credentialed Third-Party CLI Data Egress
semantic_findings.description: The skill permits belt commands and examples send prompts, image URLs, audio URLs, and video URLs to remote video apps. This is expected behavior, but it sends user data to third-party services.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed-tools declaration permits belt commands, and examples show media and prompts sent to remote apps. The behavior is transparent, so this is a data-egress risk rather than hidden abuse.

semantic_findings.title: External Skill Installation Dependency
semantic_findings.description: The skill asks users to install another belt CLI skill with npx. This creates a supply-chain dependency outside this audit scope.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The install instruction is explicit on line 7 and uses an external skill reference. It is user-initiated documentation, so severity is low.

content.value_statement: Video teams need fast access to many generation models without memorizing app IDs. This skill provides model choices and ready commands for inference.sh video workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists video model families and app IDs for text-to-video workflows.
Shows image-to-video examples for Wan, Seedance, HappyHorse, and related models.
Provides avatar and lipsync examples using image and audio inputs.
Documents video editing, foley, upscaling, and media merging utilities.
Uses the belt CLI to run inference.sh video applications.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI and authenticated inference.sh access.
Output quality depends on selected model behavior, quotas, and availability.
User media URLs must be reachable by the remote service.
Does not verify copyright, consent, or platform policy compliance.

use_cases.title: Create campaign clips
use_cases.description: Generate short product, launch, and social clips from approved creative prompts.

use_cases.title: Animate visual concepts
use_cases.description: Turn concept art, product renders, or portraits into short motion studies.

use_cases.title: Build automated video pipelines
use_cases.description: Combine generation, foley, upscaling, and merging steps for repeatable media workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple video
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to choose a fast text-to-video model and create a short clip from this prompt: [prompt].

prompt_templates.title: Animate an image
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an image-to-video request for this image URL: [url]. Use this motion direction: [direction].

prompt_templates.title: Create an avatar clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the avatar and lipsync options, then prepare a request using this portrait URL and audio URL.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a video pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow that creates visuals, adds foley, upscales output, and merges clips for this campaign goal: [goal].

output_examples.input: Create a ten-second product reveal for a new fitness tracker.
output_examples.output: Recommended model: Seedance 2.0 for polished motion and optional audio. Suggested next step: run a short prompt with product-safe wording.

output_examples.input: Animate this portrait with a short spoken message.
output_examples.output: Recommended path: use an avatar or lipsync model. Provide a portrait URL, an audio URL, and consent for the person shown.

output_examples.input: Improve a low-resolution generated clip and add sound effects.
output_examples.output: Recommended path: upscale the video first, then add foley with a concise sound prompt matched to the scene.

best_practices: Use approved prompts, source media, and consent records before generating videos.
Start with fast models for drafts, then use higher quality models for final renders.
Keep prompts specific about camera movement, duration, style, and audio needs.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential footage, private recordings, or secrets to remote models.
Do not use placeholder URLs when running a real generation request.
Do not generate likenesses or voices without permission and policy review.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI videos from text, images, references, avatars, existing clips, and audio prompts.

faq.question: Which CLI does it use?
faq.answer: It uses the inference.sh belt CLI to run supported video applications.

faq.question: Can it animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists image-to-video models and shows the required media URL inputs.

faq.question: Can it edit or upscale videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for natural language video edits, foley sound, upscaling, and merging clips.

faq.question: Does it run without an external service?
faq.answer: No. It requires authenticated access to inference.sh and available remote video models.

faq.question: What should I avoid sending?
faq.answer: Avoid secrets, private recordings, sensitive client media, and likenesses without clear permission.
